clubs.name: Paris Saint-Germain
clubs.report: Paris Saint-Germain is rated from the French league level, then from the Champions League matches already played. European titles and the five-year coefficient are not a strength bonus. Prediction markets put them at 15.3% to win the title. The last 6 matches (goals adj) average 1.896 goals for and 1.357 against, with Champions League games counted twice and domestic games counted once. They have played 5 times in the last 28 days (Champions League, Ligue 1). Goal rates are trimmed to 0.988. The injury feed has no confirmed absences on this run.
